utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard any fresh updates yet, but I’m heading out on errands and can ask around. If I learn anything about the repair drive, I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Ira. I appreciate that—please let me know if you hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Of course—I’m on it, and I’ll tell you as soon as I hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure — what’s the repair drive need from me?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: If you can, bring any spare tools or screws you’ve got. I’ll sort the rest out when you get here.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, I can bring some spare tools and screws.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So, the repair drive is still happening, right?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, I think so — but I’d want to double-check the timing and who’s bringing what so nothing gets missed.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right, so it’s still on — we just need to confirm the timing and the item list, yeah?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I might be a little scattered today, but I’m happy to help; what do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Could you bring any spare screws, a screwdriver, and maybe some tape? That would help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Absolutely—I’ll grab spare screws, a screwdriver, and some tape. If I forget anything, just give me a nudge and I’ll circle back!

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Can you share the repair drive details again so I get everything right before I help?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sure — I don’t want to miss anything either. Let me pull it together again.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Noah — take your time, and I’ll double-check everything once you send it.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Jules, I’m a bit late—what’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: No worries — we’re still gathering a few more donations, and the repair crew should have everything they need by this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Great, I’m glad it’s coming together. I’ll check back later and see if anything’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, Gus — what do you need help with for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can bring a toolbox, a hammer, and some screwdrivers—whatever you need most.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Gus — the toolbox and screwdrivers will be most helpful. If you can bring the hammer too, that’d be great.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m keeping an eye on where the repair drive is set up, so I can point folks the right way.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Opal — I’ll help keep things moving around the school schedule so people can find it. Let me know if the setup shifts.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I will — I’m watching for any location changes and I’ll pass them along right away.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? I heard they’re still collecting tools and spare parts, so I’ll keep an ear out for any updates.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, thanks, Tess — I’ll pass along any new word I hear too. If you spot anyone with extra tools or parts, send them my way!

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Will do — I’ll let you know if I hear anything, and I’ll point folks your way if I spot extra tools or parts.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Rey, are we still on for the repair drive this weekend? What do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, I’m still in. If you could bring gloves and a few tools, that’d really help.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — I’ll bring gloves and a few tools. Anything specific you want me to grab?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m on board with the repair drive — I’ll spread the word and keep people posted on the plan.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Vik — I’ll keep an ear out for updates and pass them along if I hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll keep everyone in the loop and let you know if the plan changes.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Uli — I’m getting the repair drive organized and I’d love your help. Can you tell me what needs attention on your block?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help. I’ve noticed the sidewalk crack by my gate and a loose step on the front path.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Uli — that’s really helpful. I’ll add the sidewalk crack by your gate and the loose front step to the repair list.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Eli, I heard the repair drive is kicking off soon—people are bringing tools, paint, and all sorts of odds and ends. If you want, I can keep an eye out for the exact time and place.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That would be helpful, Tess. I like to know the time and place ahead of time so I can plan my day.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely, I’ll keep an ear to the ground and let you know as soon as I hear the time and place. I’ll swing back with the details when I get them.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late—what’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No worries — I’m still lining things up, and I’ll keep everyone posted as soon as I have the next update.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Vik — just keep me posted and I’ll help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with the repair drive—what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rey. I still need to sort the list and figure out what’s most urgent.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help sort it with you—want to go through the list together and pick the urgent ones first?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure — I’m in. Just tell me what needs fixing and when to show up.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great — I’ve got a few spots in mind, and I’ll send you the locations and times so you can head straight there.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect, send them over and I’ll swing by. Keep it simple and I’ll do what I can.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’d love to help with the repair drive—what’s the first thing you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Jules — could you first help me check the supply list and see what we’re short on?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — send me the supply list and I’ll check what’s missing right away.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—right, the repair drive. I think I missed the details, but I can help if you remind me what's changed.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Noah — we’re still doing the repair drive this Saturday, but we’ve shifted the drop-off spot to the community hall entrance. I’ll send you the updated flyer so you have the details.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it — community hall entrance this Saturday. Send the flyer when you can, and I’ll keep an eye out.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard the latest on the repair drive yet—how’s it going?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: It’s coming along pretty well so far—folks have been pitching in with tools and hands, and we’re still rounding up a few more fixes.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That’s good to hear—sounds like the neighborhood’s really coming together. Let me know if you still need anything picked up.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great — could you help sort the donated tools and keep an eye on the drop-off table?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I can sort the donated tools and keep an eye on the drop-off table.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m in, but I’d like to know the pickup time and where we’re storing the repair parts first.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure — what pickup time works for you, and do you want the parts stored at my place or yours?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Let’s do pickup at 9:30 if that works, and store the parts at your place so I don’t have to shuffle them around.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m in—send me the details and I’ll spread the word around the block right away.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Quinn — we need basic tools, screws, tape, and a few flashlights. I’ll write up a quick list you can share around the block.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect — once you’ve got the list, send it over and I’ll get it to everyone on the block right away.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help line up the repair drive around school pickup times if that makes it easier.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, that’d be a huge help, Faye — thank you. Around school pickup sounds much better for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Absolutely — I’ll map it out around pickup and share a simple time window. If you have any preferred days, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’m glad we’re getting this repair drive going, Nell. I can help line up the list and make sure folks know where to bring requests.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Rosa — I’d really appreciate that. I’ll keep an ear out for neighbors and send them your way.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect — I’ll start organizing the requests and keep the neighbors updated. Thanks for helping spread the word, Nell.
